originalTitle: Largecap funds no longer the best bet? Edelweiss CIO Trideep Bhattacharya explains why flexicaps may win now
simplifiedContent: Edelweiss' chief investment officer, Trideep Bhattacharya, thinks that investing in large companies (known as largecap funds) may not be the best choice anymore. This is because the market is changing in a way that affects how much of the market these large companies control. Instead, he suggests considering flexicap and midcap funds, which may offer better opportunities for growth. He also likes financial companies and is interested in new investment areas related to artificial intelligence. This matters because it could help you decide where to put your money for potentially better returns.

originalTitle: Iran moves to close Strait of Hormuz. Should investors fear a Nifty crash in coming days?
simplifiedContent: There's a situation in Iran that might affect the global oil supply, which could make oil prices go up. This could cause the Indian stock market to be unstable and possibly go down. Investors are also paying attention to company earnings, inflation numbers, and how much money is coming into the country from foreign investors, as these factors can influence the market. All these things together might make the market go up or down in the coming days. The combination of these factors might lead to a big drop in the stock market, but it's not clear what will happen yet.

originalTitle: HCL Tech Q1 preview: Revenue may dip QoQ; net profit could rise on currency depreciation
simplifiedContent: HCL Technologies is about to release its quarterly financial results, and investors are expecting mixed news. The company's revenue, which is the total amount of money it earns, might be lower than the previous quarter, but its net profit, which is the amount of money it has left after expenses, could actually increase due to changes in currency values. This is because when other countries' currencies are weaker compared to the Indian currency, it can help Indian companies like HCL Technologies make more money from sales abroad. Investors are particularly interested in seeing how much demand there is for the company's artificial intelligence (AI) services and whether the company will change its expectations for the rest of the year. Overall, the results will give investors a better idea of how the company is performing and what to expect in the future.

originalTitle: NSE launches Nifty500 Ahimsa Index based on non-violence towards animals; check stocks, methodology, other key details
simplifiedContent: The National Stock Exchange (NSE) has introduced a new index called the Nifty500 Ahimsa Index. This index tracks companies from the Nifty 500 group that treat animals with respect and kindness, following the principle of "Ahimsa" or non-violence. The index is designed to help investors support companies that align with this value. This launch matters because it gives investors a new way to make choices based on their personal values. By investing in this index, investors can put their money into companies that prioritize animal welfare.

originalTitle: Multibagger defence stock to raise  ₹3,322 crore through fresh equity issuance
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defence industry, is planning to raise a large amount of money - ₹3,322 crore - by selling new shares. This means the company will create and sell new shares to investors, which will give it the money it needs. The company made this announcement on July 11 through a filing with the stock exchange. This is important because it shows that the company is looking to grow and invest in itself, which could potentially lead to more success in the future. By raising this money, Apollo Micro Systems may be able to expand its business and increase its value.

originalTitle: Q1 results 2026: HCL Tech, Wipro to Jio Financial among companies to declare Q1 results next week; check full list here
simplifiedContent: Some big companies, including HCL Technologies, Wipro, and several banks like HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank, will announce their financial results for the first quarter of 2026 next week. This means they will share how well they did financially from January to March 2026. These results can help investors understand how the companies are performing and make decisions about whether to buy or sell their stocks. The list of companies also includes Jio Financial Services and a few others from different industries. This is important because it can affect the stock prices of these companies and give investors an idea of their future prospects.
